promptfold.maxFiles.description: Ask before copying more than this many files. Copy what fits still stops at this limit.
promptfold.tokenBudget.description: Warn before copying a prompt estimated above this many tokens (characters / 4, approximate). The status bar turns to a warning color. 0 turns it off.
promptfold.includeGenerated.description: Include lockfiles and minified or map files (package-lock.json, yarn.lock, *.min.js, *.map and similar) when you select a folder, the whole project, an extension or Git changes. A file you check on its own is always included.
promptfold.includeTree.description: Add a tree of the selected files before the diffs, so the model sees how they are laid out. It counts toward the size limit and the token estimate.
promptfold.compactWhitespace.description: Trim the contents of files before copying: CRLF becomes LF, trailing spaces are removed and runs of two or more blank lines shrink to one. Indentation and diffs are never touched. Markdown hard line breaks (two trailing spaces) are lost.
promptfold.confirmIgnoredFolders.descrip: Ask before including a folder that is listed in .gitignore or promptfold.exclude.
promptfold.outputFormat.description: Format used when copying the prompt. XML is the default.
promptfold.diffMode.description: How Git changes appear in the prompt: diff and files, diff only, or files only.
promptfold.extensionPresets.description: Named extension lists shown first in Select by extension. Example: { "Web": ["ts", "php"] }.
promptfold.config.title: Promptfold Settings
promptfold.systemMessage.description: Optional system message to include in the output.
promptfold.exclude.description: Extra gitignore-style patterns excluded from copied context.
promptfold.allowSensitive.description: Gitignore-style patterns for secret-looking files (such as .env, keys or .npmrc) that may go into the prompt. Everything else of that kind is always left out.
promptfold.untrustedWorkspaces.descripti: In an untrusted folder, the system message and the list of allowed secret-looking files come from your user settings only, never from the folder.
promptfold.maxFileBytes.description: Skip a file larger than this many bytes.
promptfold.maxTotalBytes.description: Stop copying when the serialized prompt would exceed this many UTF-8 bytes.
promptfold.ignoredExtensions.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to ignore during recursive selection. Example: 'png,jpg,jpeg,gif,svg'
